ov: تأثير الفراشة أو (الإنجليزية: The Butterfly Effect) فيلم خيال علمي ونفسي وإثارة أمريكي، أنتج في عام 2004 من أخراج إيرك برس وبطولة أشتون كوتشر، أيمي سمارت، ألدن هنسون، وليام لي سكوت، إيريك ستولتز والإخراج لإيريك برس، جي ماكي جروبر .
plotEn:
Growing up, Evan Treborn, his friends Lenny Kagan and Kayleigh Miller, and her brother Tommy suffer severe psychological traumas that leave Evan with frequent amnesia. These include being forced by Tommy and Kayleigh’s father, George, to create child pornography with Kayleigh; nearly being strangled by his institutionalized father Jason, who is then killed by guards; accidentally killing a mother and her infant daughter while playing with dynamite; and witnessing Tommy burn Evan's dog Crockett alive. Evan keeps detailed journals as a coping mechanism.
At university, Evan discovers that reading his journals allows him to time-travel and alter his past. He realises that his blackouts occurred when his older self temporarily occupied his consciousness.
After a traumatised Kayleigh commits suicide, Evan travels back and prevents George from molesting her. He returns to a reality in which he and Kayleigh are a happy couple, but George has instead directed his abuse towards Tommy, who has become violent and dangerous. When Tommy attacks Evan, Evan kills him in self-defence and is imprisoned. His mother brings him a journal, enabling him to time-travel again.
Evan returns to stop Tommy killing Crockett, but Lenny, driven to instability by Tommy's bullying and the dynamite incident, kills Tommy with a metal shard.
